facts: The national heritage temple consists of three linked hall rows. A hexagonal seven-story relic stupa of approximately 32 meters stands in front of the main hall.

record: Ho Chi Minh City official cultural visitor record
facts: The surviving temple at 565 Lạc Long Quân is associated with the Lâm Tế lineage and was founded in 1744.

record: Ho Chi Minh City Fine Arts Association historical arts volume
facts: At the entrance the 32.7-meter, seven-hexagonal-tier Bảo tháp Xá Lợi is on the left. It was completed in 1994.
